name: 超级形态
description: 获得两点临时行动点。本回合索尼克使用技能不消耗动能，回合结束后保留。AP：0 CP：3 CD：3
code: function executeSkill(context){var c=context.piece,player=context.battle.players.find(function(item){return item.playerId===c.ownerPlayerId;});if(player)player.actionPoints=(player.actionPoints||0)+2;c.statusTags=(c.statusTags||[]).filter(function(t){return t.type!=='preserve-momentum';});c.statusTags.push({id:'preserve-momentum-'+c.instanceId,type:'preserve-momentum',name:'超级形态',stacks:1,currentDuration:1,untilTurn:context.battle.turn.turnNumber});return {success:true,message:'获得2点临时行动点，本回合动能不会被消耗'};}
